d: Cricket's ambitions in Europe are growing and Spain wants to be part of that expansion. A new cricket ground near Alicante is being developed with hopes of attracting IPL and Test matches, while leagues, investment and growing participation are creating fresh opportunities across the continent. With Italy reaching the 2026 T20 World Cup and the European T20 Premier League bringing franchise cricket to new markets, Rupha Ramani looks at if Europe can become cricket's next growth story?
